  1. PR #73858 — [WebRTC] Concurrent RTCPeerConnections allocate O(N^2) UDP sockets
    WebKit · score 5/15 · confiance moyenne
    Élément modifié. Pull request, état : open

    #### 805f1f2b8b4fb05611aebf91c771dfc760e3d663 [WebRTC] Concurrent RTCPeerConnections allocate O(N^2) UDP sockets https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=321225 rdar://184396090 Reviewed by NOBODY (OOPS!). All the RTCPeerConnections of a document share one LibWebRTCNetworkManager and every port allocator session subscribes to it, so StartUpdating() signals all of them. libwebrtc is built for that: OnNetworksChanged() only allocates once allocation_started_ has been set in OnAllocate(), so a signal arriving before a session allocates is free.
